newsitem.title: UK: OPTIONS - BTR calls active after FT report.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS - BTR calls active after FT report.

text.p: Options in UK industrial conglomerate BTR Plc were active on Wednesday, with a sizeable buyer of calls in the stock, options traders said.
With the underlying shares dropping 6-1/2p to 231-1/2, 615 lots of the February 240p calls were traded along with 270 of the February 280p calls.

Earlier today a report in the Financial Times said a fourth-quarter trading statement was expected from BTR this week but was unlikely to relieve the scepticism that has overshadowed the stock in recent weeks.
In banking group Lloyds TSB Plc, options specialists reported a seller of the December 330p calls and December 420 calls.
Two hundred lots of the former were traded and 206 lots of the latter.
Lloyds shares were up 2p at 425 in a generally weak market after analysts at two brokerages raised profit estimates on the company.
In the FTSE 100 options dealers said there were was buying of puts and selling of calls in what looked like insurance trades by local traders.
Some 3,565 lots of the December 4,150 calls were traded along with 1,387 of the December 3,900 puts and 1,832 of the December 4,000 puts.
